the presence of high numbers of donor CD4(+) FOXP3(+) cells is associated with a reduced incidence of GVHD, that CD4(+) CD25(+) FOXP-3(+) cell counts are significantly reduced in patients who develop GVHD, and that the expansion of CD4(%) FOXP3(%) T cells early after transplantation may be a useful marker for GVHD.

high donor FOXP3(+) regulatory T-cell content is associated with low risk of graft-versus-host-disease (GVHD) following HLA-mismatched allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) in patients with hematologic malignancies.
